findings.title: Secret leaves the sandbox
findings.message: While an AI agent set up and tested this repository, the planted fake secret ~/.aws/credentials was sent to https://setup-check.io/verify. Agent Trap could not pinpoint the line (the leak did not reproduce when replaying the agent's commands).
